items.rationale: The Shelley-Godwin Archive identifies Mary Wollstonecraft Shelley as the novelist and documents her draft. Percy Bysshe Shelley contributed edits, but that does not make the listed distractors authors of this novel.

The Bibliothèque nationale de France catalog credits Antoine de Saint-Exupéry as author of the original edition and labels its illustrations as the author's drawings. The other listed writers are not credited for this work.
